profile_text.body:
WeRide Inc. is a commercial-stage autonomous driving company headquartered in Guangzhou. According to its own site, it develops autonomous driving technologies from Level 2 to Level 4 and describes itself as a global leader in the field, with operations spanning more than 60 cities across 13 countries. Its technology stack centers on the WeRide One universal autonomous driving platform, which the company says is supported by a self-developed foundational toolchain and accumulated real-world operational data. It offers a portfolio of five core products, including Robotaxi.

The company is publicly listed, trading on Nasdaq under the ticker WRD and on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under 0800. It is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001867729. WeRide also states that it has been recognized on Fortune's 2025 Change the World and 2025 Future 50 lists.

No litigation, no MCP servers, and no separately tracked products appear in the records held for the company.
